messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: Velora renewal coming up in ~80 days. Procurement says signer is delegated and they require PO routing. Also SSO claim mismatch flagged that could delay onboarding.
Raj (AM): Thanks. Any pricing/term asks?
Lina (CS): Theyrequested a shorter 9-month option and asked about an early-sign discount. Procurement prefers PO over card.
Sam (Finance): PO ok. Need vendor code + invoice entity. Net30?
Raj (AM): Yes, Velora prefers PO + Net30. They might switch to CC for speed but procurement wants PO.
Elena (Legal): For delegated signer we need a delegation letter (signed officer auth). If provided we can set DocuSign recipient; otherwise exec signature required.
Lina (CS): Plan: 1) Ask for delegation PDF + PO number + vendor code; 2) Send DocuSign to delegated signer; 3) Tentative enablement 2 weeks after signature; 4) Offer 5% early-commit discount if signed in 30 days.
Sam (Finance): 5% ok but will need pricebook update. Also share PO example format.
Raj (AM): I'll request PO number and delegation PDF now.
Onboard-bot: Tentative enablement slots blocked: May 6-8 and May 13-15.
Lina (CS): Action items: Raj - request docs (2bd); Elena - draft acknowledgement (EOD); Sam - prep pricebook change (3bd); Onboarding - block slots and prep SSO checklist (2bd).
Raj (AM): Velora replied: PO VEL-PO-2026-0421, delegated signer Priya Rao. Delegation PDF attached.
Elena (Legal): Drafted acknowledgement, uploading now.
Onboard-bot: DocuSign envelope created env_0a1b2c. Recipient Priya Rao.
Onboard-bot: Envelope env_0a1b2c signed. Signed copy: https://docusign.example/signed/env_0a1b2c.pdf
Sam (Finance): Received signed copy and vendor code VEL-VC-889. Issuing invoice Net30.
Onboard-bot: Enablement locked May 6-8. Invites sent.
Lina (CS): Great work. Closing loop when invoice is sent. :white_check_mark:
